name:
The Lodge at Woodloch
Meals & More Included
positioning: The Lodge, Destination Spa at Woodloch: an adults-only, all-inclusive spa resort in the Poconos, Pennsylvania
best_for: Adults looking for an all-inclusive spa and wellness retreat
Travelers who want daily classes, workshops and guest speakers included in the rate

facts.text: The Lodge at Woodloch is an all-inclusive spa resort in the Poconos, Pennsylvania.
The spa resort is restricted to adult guests.
All packages include accommodations and three gourmet meals per night of stay.
Packages include speakers and workshops, creative arts, group fitness and mind/body classes, cooking and baking demonstrations, and group outdoor adventure excursions.
The resort has a 3,000-square-foot CardioWeight Studio.
The spa has a co-ed Whisper Lounge.
Spa treatments and services are customized to each guest's wellness goals.
Guest speakers and events cover topics including life, love, self, spirituality, health, music, healing and the environment.
The spa cuisine uses ingredients from three working gardens on the property and from local farms.
Travel + Leisure readers named it among their 20 favorite spas in the world of 2025.
The resort's tradition is to treat guests as if they are company in the owners' own home.

highlights.text: The Aqua Garden has Hydromassage WaterWalls and an activity pool with floor-to-ceiling windows surrounded by nature.
Included wellness amenities feature an indoor pool, indoor and outdoor whirlpools, steam rooms, saunas, a Snow Room, a Tyrolean Bucket Shower and a Himalayan Salt Sauna.
The resort offers over 50 classes and offerings per day.
TREE Restaurant and Bar is elevated among the tree canopy with glimpses of the resort's private lake.

considerations.text: The resort is for adult guests only, so it is not a family option.
Stays are sold as all-inclusive packages that include three meals per night of stay.
WhataHotel notes the remote mountain location requires travel planning.
